reason: C provides the strongest compositions across both text sizes: Ask prioritizes reviewing the question; Why separates evidence discovery from sustained reading. Scores use A=mean(hierarchy, typography, surfaces), F=mean(clarity, accessibility), and overall=0.4A+0.6F rounded to one decimal. Feedback is N/A because interaction outcomes cannot be graded from these screenshots; its numeric placeholder is excluded. Component tuples use the same six dimensions and exclude N/A entries when normalized. Neither winner meets the authorized threshold, and several components remain below 8. No hard-gate failure is established: the supplied evidence states that all content is reachable.
limitations: Independent assessment used only the six attached images and the stated evidence boundaries. No source, prior grades or other graders were consulted.
Prototype functional scores describe provisional structural expectations. Submit does not request a forecast; these compositions are not demonstrated end-to-end replacements.
Implement and verify engine submission, pending/error/retry states, input preservation, export and voice integration before crediting those prototype capabilities.
Verify keyboard avoidance, focused-field visibility and scroll clearance around Ask actions at 200%. The captured overlap in A/B is a concern, not proof of unreachable content.
Verify disclosure and section navigation semantics, selected-state announcements, keyboard focus, return-focus behavior and preserved reading position. Visible back links alone do not prove recovery.

Close controls appear very small; screenshots cannot establish their actual 44pt hit areas. Prototype contrast, reduced motion and assistive-technology behavior are not established by production tests.
Production browser checks are acknowledged only for baseline. They do not transfer to alternatives or provide missing screenshots of loading, error and recovery behavior.

The repeated synthetic reasoning is an intentional layout fixture and received no model-quality penalty. Physical iPhone and VoiceOver proof remains a separate later gate, not an automatic browser-score ceiling.
